items.quote: The V2 API requires an access token to authenticate requests.
items.why: Says V2 needs access token; doesn't name oauth2 or bearer_token methods.

items.quote: Implementing a full OAuth2 Authentication flow which allows other people to use your Harvest integrations.
items.why: States OAuth2 flow for other users; bearer_token and PAT method not covered.

items.quote: Personal Access Tokens have the `all` scope by default, so you have full access to all of your accounts.
items.why: Quote is about default token scope, not plan gate or self-serve creation.

items.quote: The Harvest V2 API is a REST API that allows you to interact with your Harvest account programmatically.
items.why: Confirms REST API for programmatic access; endpoint breadth and rate limits not shown.

items.quote: The rate limit for general API requests is 100 requests per 15 seconds.
items.why: States general 100 req/15s limit; reports limit and User-Agent not shown.

items.quote: Run a time report for a date range, grouped by project, by client, or by person. Each total is split into billable and non-billable hours.
items.why: Quote describes a time report feature; says nothing about an MCP server or vendor status.
